account_creation_treatment: frozen model treats as recoverable; live wallet capital remains locked until the empty account is actually closed and rent is reclaimed
failed_transaction_cost: zero when never landed; when landed and failed, base and prioritization fees may still be charged, so the actual fee must come from transaction metadata
shadow_expected_pnl: frozen curve-modeled sell proceeds minus 0.1 SOL position cost minus frozen estimated base/priority fees; Pump fees are already in the curve replay and account creation is treated as recoverable
actual_live_realized_pnl: observed sell wallet credit minus observed buy wallet debit minus all successful and failed transaction fees/tips/optional fees minus unrecovered rent/account effects
reconciliation: ACTUAL_LIVE_REALIZED_PNL - SHADOW_EXPECTED_PNL; also decompose entry price degradation, exit price degradation, fees, failures, and rent
